world_org_meetings.title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
world_org_meetings.description: Denmark and the US have reached an agreement after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump signs sweeping Russia sanctions bill
world_org_meetings.description: The bill is named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, a staunch advocate of aid for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: The new lines of southern Lebanon
world_org_meetings.description: The U.N. expanded the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon's mandate 20 years ago to include monitoring adherence to a ceasefire in fighting between Israel and Lebanon's Iran-backed Hezbollah — the militant group created in 1982 to counter a second Israeli invasion.

world_org_meetings.title: Head of European Investment Bank eyes Canada opportunities as Carney pushes EU ties
world_org_meetings.description: The president of the European Union's investment bank says "the time is ripe" to deepen its co-operation with Canada by exploring how to finance Canadian projects — comments that come as Prime Minister Mark Carney pushes for more EU ties.

world_org_meetings.title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles off east coast in three hours
world_org_meetings.description: North Korea launched two missiles off its eastern coast on Sunday, its second set of tests in roughly a week and days after Pyongyang accused the U.S. of driving tensions on the Korean Peninsula through a series of military drills.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spanish royals welcome French President Macron in official ceremony
diplomatic_visits.description: Spain's King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia welcomed French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte Macron during an official ceremony upon their arrival at Madrid's Royal Palace. French President Macron is on a two-day official visit in Spain. This state visit will serve to highlight and strengthen the ties and bilateral relations between the two countries. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, Spain.

diplomatic_visits.title: UAE confirms president met with Israel's PM Netanyahu in Abu Dhabi on Sunday
diplomatic_visits.description: The visit came weeks after a bombshell Israeli media report that the Emirati president had warned Netanyahu ahead of the Hamas-led attack on Israel in 2023, which the Israeli premier did not pass on to the security services.

diplomatic_visits.title: Trump offered to sell arms to China during Xi visit, US ambassador tells Fox News
diplomatic_visits.description: The United States is required by law to supply Taiwan, which has a democratically elected president and legislature, with weapons for its defence under the 1979 Taiwan Relations Act.

diplomatic_visits.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

diplomatic_visits.title: Protection for women who defy the Mafia is changing in Italy. Does it go far enough?
diplomatic_visits.description: For women speaking out against the Mafia, the protection offered can be both practically and emotionally challenging. A new Italian law extending protection from organized crime to children and the adults caring for them — often their mothers — is designed to address some of that gap.

elections.title: Trump trade adviser says Canada will 'pay even more dearly' if 'you interfere' in U.S. midterms
elections.description: One of U.S. President Donald Trump's trade advisers is threatening repercussions for Canada if it "interferes" in the upcoming midterm elections — though it's not clear what he anticipates the country would do to impact the vote.

elections.title: Serbia's populist President Vucic resigns to run for prime minister at early vote
elections.description: Serbia’s populist President Aleksandar Vucic has resigned the post to pursue a bid to become the prime minister in an upcoming early parliamentary election

elections.title: A view from Brazil: The fight for the favela vote
elections.description: In Brazil, more than 158 million voters are being called to the polls on Sunday to elect their next president, as well as new members of Congress and governors. In Rio de Janeiro, local candidates are fighting for one particularly sought-after electorate: the residents of favelas. FRANCE 24’s Jan Onoszko reports from Rocinha, Brazil’s largest favela.

elections.title: French far-right leader Bardella denies anti-Semitism accusations
elections.description: 🇫🇷 ✡️ Far-right #NationalRally (RN) party leader Jordan #Bardella has denied accusation by French investigative website #Mediapart that he made anti-Semitic comments on private chats in 2013. It comes as RN candidate Marine #LePen is polling well in the lead for the 2027 presidential election.

elections.title: France's Le Pen defiant after top ally hit by antisemitism claims
elections.description: French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen on Tuesday vowed to hit back at allegations of antisemitism targeting her de-facto number two Jordan Bardella, which have punctured her buoyant campaign at a time she is riding high in the polls. Le Pen, who is aiming to win the Elysee at her fourth attempt next year in a far-right breakthrough that would send a shockwave across Europe, lambasted the Mediapart website that published the claims and said Bardella has her "total confidence".
